items.title: Heavy rains leave tens of thousands without shelter in Gaza: local authorities
items.summary: Heavy rain on Saturday flooded tens of thousands of displaced people's tents in war-devastated Gaza, Palestinian authorities said, leaving them without shelter. In a statement, the Hamas-run government media office said that about "70,000 tents sheltering tens of thousands of displaced people were flooded on the first day" of rains. It also noted the "collapse of dozens of cracked walls and roofs, which caused injuries", some critical, in various areas of the tiny territory.

ai.sum: Heavy rain flooded about 70,000 tents sheltering displaced people in Gaza, leaving tens of thousands without shelter.

items.title: Heavy rain floods tents housing Gaza displaced people, aid shortages hamper response
items.summary: By Dawoud Abu Alkas and Nidal al-Mughrabi GAZA/CAIRO, Nov 7 (Reuters) - Heavy rains have flooded tens of thousands of tents housing displaced Palestinians crammed into encampments across the Gaza Strip, washing away shelters and soaking blankets and mattresses, local authorities said on Saturday. The Hamas-run Gaza government media office said at least 70,000 tents had been flooded in the past 12 hours, affecting tens of thousands of displaced people and causing injuries…

ai.sum: Heavy rains flooded tens of thousands of tents housing displaced Palestinians in Gaza, with aid shortages hampering the response.
